description: Angular component for a persistent table widget in Thingsboard UI, managing RPC requests with filtering, pagination, and actions.

classes.name: PersistentDatasource
classes.description: Data source class for managing persistent RPC requests, handling data fetching, error handling, and state management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up configuration, and observes resize events for responsive layout.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer on component destruction.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up data update subscriptions after view initialization.

methods.name: initializeConfig
methods.description: Configures component settings, columns, pagination, sorting, and CSS styling.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Fetches and updates data based on current pagination and sorting state.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Triggers change detection after data update.

methods.name: deleteRpcRequest
methods.description: Deletes a persistent RPC request after user confirmation.

methods.name: openRequestDetails
methods.description: Opens a dialog with details of a persistent RPC request.

methods.name: addPersistentRpcRequest
methods.description: Opens a dialog to add a new persistent RPC request.

methods.name: sendRequests
methods.description: Sends a RPC request via control API, handling one-way or two-way commands.

methods.name: onActionButtonClick
methods.description: Handles action button clicks for details or delete actions.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Opens overlay panel to edit RPC status filter.
